canonical_project: City Connect ICT Research and Data Center Brezice
notes: Announced as an ICT research/communication/data center for central and western Europe, expected by mid-2021 with about EUR 3m investment and 150-200 jobs over two years. Later public listings confirm City Connect d.o.o. at Cesta svobode 37, 8250 Brezice, but no public source found verifying MW capacity or physical data-center completion.
